article: 日本記者クラブの生成AI講演動画3本
scope: Compared titles, descriptions, speaker names and roles, dates, all three embedded video IDs, links, and complete translated articles against the Japanese source and official Japan National Press Club event records.
findings: Removed duplicate future dates, retained the 2024-04-16 publication date, and set lastmod to the review date.
Changed the recommendation framing to a neutral list of three recorded talks; the source provides no comparative basis for calling them recommended or identifying the speakers as leading researchers.
Confirmed Nakao on 2023-09-08, Sakai on 2023-10-11, and Matsuo on 2024-03-15 against the Club’s event records.
Added the corresponding official Club event record below each embedded video in Japanese and all twelve translations.
Retained the original YouTube embeds and the short list format; did not characterize the talks’ claims as settled facts.
